title: Last Argument of Kings
author: Joe Abercrombie
review:
Liked it, didn't love it. More like 3.75 stars than 3. Things from the last book make more sense now and are more or less wrapped up thankfully. The ending was somewhat overly long and overstayed its welcome a bit, could have been a bit tighter wrapping things up, didn't have to know every last detail of how things ended up for the B and C plots.

This series is a bit overhyped in my opinion, had a lot more enjoyment from a Song of Ice and Fire and Malazan at their highs than this series. I did enjoy my time with some of the characters, world building here was not too great and the political intrigue leaves a lot to be desired.
